chinese: 大哥哥，我好想回家，你放我走好不好？
english: Mister, I want to go home so badly. Please, will you let me down?

chinese: 好！我放你下來
english: All right. I'll get you down.

chinese: 以後不要在街上亂丟石頭了！
english: And no more throwing stones in the street, understand?

chinese: 好的，大哥哥！我要回家了，大哥哥再見！
english: I promise, mister! I'm going home now. Goodbye!

chinese: 小孩子怎麼不見了？你在這幹嗎？小子．．．人是你放走的吧！
english: Where did the boy go? What are you doing here? You... you're the one who cut him down!

chinese: 我的直覺告訴我趕快跑！
english: Every instinct I have is telling me to run.

chinese: 是誰？你人在那裡？我的眼睛不好，出個聲好不好？
english: Who's there? Where are you? My eyes are bad. Say something, would you?

chinese: 老婆婆我．．．我有點麻煩，你能不能幫助我？
english: Grandmother, I... I'm in some trouble. Could you help me?

chinese: 有個小男孩因拿石頭砸到修斯王子而被吊在樹上
english: A boy threw a stone at Prince Sius, and they strung him up in a tree for it.

chinese: 我放走那孩子碰巧被衛兵看到，現在我如被追逐的獵物般無處可躲！
english: I cut him down and a guard happened to see me. Now I'm hunted game with nowhere to hide.

chinese: 小男孩的事情我也聽說過．．．修斯王子是個喜怒無常的人
english: I heard about that boy... Prince Sius is a man of sudden moods.

chinese: 樓上有個窗子，你往那逃走吧！
english: There's a window upstairs. Go out that way, quickly!

chinese: 是不是有個混蛋來過這裡？
english: Has some bastard come through here?
N-no... no one!

chinese: 有人看到他跑到妳家，不介意我們檢查吧！
english: He was seen running to your house. You won't mind if we take a look.

chinese: 你們想怎樣？求求你們不要為難我！
english: What do you want from me? Please, don't do this!

chinese: 我上樓發現了推開的窗子與腳印，顯然這老女人欺騙了我們！
english: Upstairs I found the window pushed open, and footprints. The old woman lied to us.

chinese: 老太婆妳用不著擺著一副驚慌無措的表情！早點結束對妳我都好！
english: Don't put on that frightened face, old woman. The sooner this ends, the better for us both.

chinese: 總要有個交差的對像，妳去死吧！
english: Someone has to answer for it. Die.

chinese: 這算什麼！怯懦的行為，荒謬的過程！無理的暴行，悲慘的結果！
english: What was that? A coward's act, an absurd pretext. Senseless brutality, a wretched end.

chinese: 這到底是個什麼朝代．．．？我要推翻它，一定要推翻它！
english: What kind of dynasty is this...? I will bring it down. I swear I will bring it down.
